CHAPTER.VERS: For we have da'as that if our beit mishkaneinu [Iyov 4:19; II Cor.4:7] is made churban, we have a bais from Hashem, a bais not made with hands, in Shomayim L'olamim. [Yeshayah 38:12]
For indeed in this mishkaneinu we groan, longing for the train of our robe to be our sukkah from shomayim. [Rom. 8:23]
-- if indeed thus clothed we will not be found naked.
For while we are still in this Mishkan, we groan under our burden, in as much as we do not want to be unclothed but to be clothed, that the mortal may be swallowed up by chayyim. [I Cor. 15:53-54]

Now the one having prepared us for this very thing is Hashem, the One having given us the eravon
pledge of the Ruach Hakodesh. [Rom 8:16,23; II Cor 1:22; Eph 1:13]

Therefore we always have bittachon, since we have da'as that being at home in the guf
body , we are away from home in Adoneinu. [Heb. 11:13-16]

For we walk by emunah
faith , not by sight; [I Cor. 13:12]

therefore we have bittachon and are pleased rather to leave home from the guf
body and to be at home with Adoneinu. [Php 1:23]
Therefore, also we are aspiring, whether at home or away from home to be well pleasing to Hashem, [Col. 1:10; I Thes 4:1]

since it is necessary for all of us to be revealed for an appearance before the Kisse Din of Rebbe, Melech HaMoshiach
Judgment throne of Moshiach , so that each one of us may be recompensed for the things done through the basar, according to his ma'asim
works , whether tov or rah. [Kohelet 12:14; Acts 17:31; Rom. 2:16;14:10] THE BRIT CHADASHA AND THE NOSEI K'LEI HASHEM
ONES CARRYING THE VESSELS OF HASHEM , THE SHERUT OF HITRATZTZUT
RECONCILIATION

Therefore, since we have da'as of the yirat [Rebbe Melech HaMoshiach] Adoneinu, we persuade men, and we have been made manifest to Hashem and I have tikvah
hope also that we have been made manifest to your
consiences matzpunim. [Iyov 23:15; II Cor.4:2]

We are not commending ourselves to you again [II Cor 3:1], but are giving an opportunity to you of glorying on behalf of us [II Cor.1:14] that you may respond to those who glory in appearance and not in lev.
For if we seem meshuga, it is for Hashem; if we are in our right mind, it is for you.

For the ahavah
love of Rebbe, Melech HaMoshiach controls us, because we have judged this, that one [Moshiach] died on behalf of all and therefore all died.

And Moshiach died, on behalf of all, [I Tim 2:6] that the ones living may live no longer to themselves but to the one [Moshiach] who died on behalf of them has been made to stand up alive in his techiyas hamesim. [Rom 14:7-8]

From now on, therefore, we have da'as of no one from a purely human point of view; if indeed we have had da'as of Rebbe, Melech HaMoshiach according to the basar we now no longer so have da'as of him,

so that if anyone is in Rebbe, Melech HaMoshiach, he is a bria chadasha
a new being [Rom 8:1,10; Gal. 6:15]: the old things passed away; hinei, all has become chadash. [Yeshayah 43:18; 65:17; Rev. 21:5]

And all things are of Hashem, who is the one having granted to us ritztzuy
reconciliation to himself through Rebbe, Melech HaMoshiach [Rom 5:10] and has given to us the sherut haRitztzuy
the ministry of reconciliation ,

davka
specifically), that Hashem was in Rebbe, Melech HaMoshiach reconciling the Olam to himself, [Rom. 3:24-25; Col 1:19-20 not reckoning their avonot against them and putting in us
the message of reconciliation Dvar HaRitztzuy.

On behalf of Rebbe, Melech HaMoshiach, therefore, we are emissaries of shalom [Yeshayah 27:5; 52:7; Eph. 6:20], as if Hashem were entreating through us: we ask on behalf of Rebbe, Melech HaMoshiach, be reconciled to Hashem.

The one who in his person was without da'as of chet
transgression [Act 3:14; Jo. 8:46; Heb. 4:15; 7:26; I Pet. 2:22; I Jo. 3:5], this one Hashem made a sin offering, chattat kapparah [Gal. 3:13; Yeshayah 53:10] on our behalf that we might become the Tzedek [DANIEL 9:25] of Hashem in Rebbe, Melech HaMoshiach. [I Cor 1:30; Php. 3:9]
